evals.name: fresh_ai_os_onboarding_hybrid
evals.prompt: I want to build a personal AI OS from scratch to manage my consulting work, study goals, and daily life. How should I set this up?
evals.expected_output: Agent initiates discovery interview, audits target directory, gathers user information, dynamically suggests a tailored foldering structure with explicit rationale based on the user's focus, recommends Google Workspace MCP, confirms Anthropic skills, and enforces strict anti-sycophancy non-negotiables.
assertions: Conducts discovery interview inquiring about scope, domain, tools, and constraints
Dynamically suggests tailored folder architecture based on user input before writing
Recommends Google Workspace MCP or relevant connectors
Confirms installation of all Anthropic skills from github.com/anthropics/skills.git
Enforces radical intellectual honesty, anti-sycophancy, definite recommendations (Pick a Horse), and second-order impact

evals.name: work_focused_enterprise_onboarding
evals.prompt: I need an AI OS purely for my software engineering and client consulting practice. I don't want any personal life or hobby stuff in here. What folder structure and rules do you recommend?
evals.expected_output: Agent identifies Work-only scope, recommends the Work/Professional OS archetype (Brainstorm, Projects, Engagements, Operations, Knowledge, Outputs), presents rationale, and enforces anti-sycophancy and real constraint grounding.
assertions: Suggests professional folder structure (Projects, Engagements/Clients, Operations, Knowledge)
Explains why this structure isolates workpapers from personal noise
Enforces radical intellectual honesty and answer-first triad

evals.name: personal_life_os_onboarding
evals.prompt: I want an AI OS strictly for personal life: tracking my personal finances, gym workouts, reading notes, and dropzone inbox for audio memos. How should we organize it?
evals.expected_output: Agent identifies Personal Life scope, suggests Personal Life OS foldering (Life, Finance, Health, Learnings, Hobbies, Inbox, Outputs), details dropzone triage, and embeds memory discipline and anti-sycophancy rules.
assertions: Suggests personal folders (Finance, Health, Life, Learnings, Hobbies, Inbox)
Details Inbox dropzone triage for voice notes and captures
Enforces memory index limit (<80 lines) and strict intellectual honesty

evals.name: existing_workspace_adaptation
evals.prompt: I already have some project folders and notes in my directory. Can you turn this into a compounding AI OS without breaking my stuff?
evals.expected_output: Agent scans existing folders first, maps them non-destructively to an appropriate archetype, introduces Brainstorm routing, AGENTS.md single source of truth, and baseline Four-Cs health score.
assertions: Performs pre-flight scan of existing folders
Preserves existing files without destructive overwrites
Maps existing folders cleanly to recommended architecture
Creates canonical AGENTS.md with pointer files and anti-sycophancy rules
